info.title: INVENTRAK Inventory Management API
info.description: Backend API for the INVENTRAK inventory management system. Both the SQLite (Express) backend and the npm-free fallback expose this identical contract. Live docs: GET /api/docs

TooManyRequests.description: Too many failed login attempts for this account; the account is temporarily locked

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before the account unlocks

email_verified.description: False for accounts that registered but have not yet redeemed their email/SMS verification code

phone.description: PH mobile number required at registration (for SMS verification + order updates)

notify.description: Verification-code delivery status (register only; login does not send codes)

password.description: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, number, and symbol

phone.description: Valid PH mobile number (09171234567, +639171234567 or 639171234567). Required — used for SMS verification and order updates under the Data Privacy Act (RA 10173).

password.description: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, number, and symbol

image.description: Product photo: '/images/<file>' served by the backend, or a full URL
Product photo: '/images/<file>' served by the backend, or a full URL

notify.description: Delivery status of the verification code (present only when a code was actually generated: register + resend-verification). email is always attempted; sms only when a phone was provided.

current_qty.description: Stock at the location before approval

customer_phone.description: Mobile number for SMS status updates (optional)

payment_status.description: GCash/card payment state (COD inquiries stay unpaid)

payment_url.description: PayMongo checkout URL (real gateway) when configured

payment_qr.description: QR image URL the customer scans to pay

user_id.description: Account that placed the inquiry (null for legacy/guest orders)

status_history.description: JSON array of { status, at } progress events (Placed -> Approved -> Delivered)

payment.description: Payment step for GCash/card checkout (present when payment_method is gcash or card)

text.description: Raw OCR-extracted text from the uploaded image

matches.description: Catalog products fuzzy-matched from the OCR text, best first

dailySalesValue.description: Sales value per day, last 7 days
